positiveEvidence.title: Condizioni Generali di Contratto Hera Ricarica Pubblica
positiveEvidence.details: Official gruppohera.it contract terms confirm a post-charge occupancy fee after 60 minutes: EUR 0.08/min for Type 2/3A connectors from 07:00-23:00 and EUR 0.15/min for the other connector category described by the contract. This is first-party evidence for an ancillary time component, but not evidence of the current energy EUR/kWh component.

updates.decision: retain the official occupancy component as first-party evidence but keep HER fail-closed for ranking: current energy price and deterministic physical-operator/station mapping are still missing. Do not combine this historical contract component with the mirrored 2025 energy brochure as if they were one current tariff.
updates.resumeCondition: Obtain current first-party Hera energy tariff payload/document or app/backend response with operator/station/EVSE mapping and effective dates.
updates.confidence: high for contract occupancy evidence / insufficient for current complete rankable tariff

history: 2026-09-15 run200: added official HeraRicarica contract evidence for post-charge occupancy fees; explicitly kept it separate from the unconfirmed current energy component and preserved fail-closed ranking.
